amendment_note: Replaces the invalid v1.3 language evidence after discovering that cyclic CorpusFamily shuffled individual tokens and erased sequence structure. Uses contiguous cyclic reads and the inverse-likelihood categorical functional-ANOVA basis of Ferrere et al. (2026), arXiv:2603.02673, Definition 3.1 and equation (19). Tabular and image evidence are unchanged.

paper.title: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs Models
paper.text_interpretation: each lagged token position is one categorical variable; output is the next-token one-hot vector; degree is context-position interaction order

sequence_semantics.cyclic_reuse: contiguous circular read; tokens are never permuted
sequence_semantics.old_language_cells: invalid for sequence learnability and never reused

profile.crossfit: alternating target positions; both directions averaged
profile.degree_1: Formula-(19) constant plus single-position inverse-likelihood column span
profile.solver: nested weighted L2 projections; algebraically equivalent column spans without materializing q^2 columns
profile.limitations: pairwise profile measures degrees 0-2 over selected lags; it is not a full 64-position spectrum

rungs.source: cached pinned TinyStories decoded to UTF-8 bytes

preflight.gate: copy learning minus markov2 learning >= 2.0 bits

confirmation.difficulty_secondary: initial CE minus final CE; higher is easier
confirmation.controlled_pass_rule: profile effective degree markov2 > copy, median curve-area difference markov2-copy >= 0.03, and median learning difference copy-markov2 >= 1.0 bit
confirmation.controlled_fail_rule: profile ordering is reversed or curve-area difference <= 0 or learning difference <= 0
confirmation.natural_analysis: descriptive Spearman across the two natural and two synthetic rungs; no standalone significance claim at n=4
